summary: Approved Gradium startup grants provide 54M credits worth over $2,000 through six months of the M plan, covering TTS, STT and voice cloning APIs plus technical support. Eligibility requires a Seed or Series A round, fewer than 25 employees, and voice as a core product component with a clear monetization strategy; one-off projects are not eligible. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis with an aim to respond in two to three business days.
claim_steps: Confirm your startup has raised Seed or Series A, has fewer than 25 employees, and has voice as a core product component with a clear monetization strategy; one-off projects do not qualify.
Submit the official application at https://gradium.ai/startups/apply.
Wait for rolling review; Gradium aims to respond within two to three business days.
If accepted, activate the six-month M plan grant. When credits run out, continuing requires subscribing to a standard plan.

social_proof.title: Startup Program: Free Voice AI Credits for Startups | Gradium
social_proof.text: Grant recipients receive 6 months of our M plan completely free. That is 54 million credits worth over $2,000, equivalent to 1,200 hours of TTS or 4,998 hours of STT.
